gate: G1 re-run feed (Phase 2 paper-trading); G2 = infrastructure proof only
mandate: 60-day live OJ paper-trading harness to accumulate scored OOS event-trades to N >= N_min (8) and re-run G1

cycle.same_day_fill: 12Z publishes before the 14:00 NY close -> same-day fill on trading days
cycle.non_signal_cycles: 00/06/18Z not ingested for the signal path (18Z publishes after the cutoff)

signal.name: ColdGrip
signal.theta_p_estimator: median(freeze_prob) over historical PIT rows with freeze_prob>0 and date <= G1 date (2026-08-12)
signal.theta_p_frozen_at: G1 date, BEFORE any live event is recorded; single value, no live re-estimation
signal.theta_t_origin: fixed physical freeze definition, not estimated
signal.re_estimation: only at the N >= N_min G1 re-run, under the same estimator, on the accumulated historical + live ledger; the new value is frozen in a new protocol version (change control)
signal.entry: first firing row of each live episode

trade.entry: fill at the first trading-session close ON/AFTER the firing row's cycle date; same-day for trading days, next trading close for weekend/holiday cycles; NEVER prior close
trade.exit: close of the 2nd trading session after the fill session
trade.costs_breakdown: 5 bps commission + 10 bps slippage per position change x2
trade.episode: maximal run of live rows with freeze_prob>0 grouped by executable fill session; split iff fill sessions are >= 2 trading sessions apart

benchmark.live_rbar: recomputed at the N >= N_min G1 re-run on the accumulated window with the WS-1 formula (mean of matched always-long OJ 2-session returns)

event_counting.scored: live OOS event-trades (in the paper window, not embargoed)

decision_rules.PASS: N>=N_min and net-of-benchmark event Sharpe>1.0 and bootstrap CI lower bound>0
decision_rules.FAIL_PIVOT: N>=N_min and (CI includes 0 or mean net<=0)
decision_rules.ZERO_TRADES: no live trades -> documented (architecture success path)

armor.timestamp: publication_ts <= decision cutoff (14:00 America/New_York) of the fill session
armor.vintage: fetched bytes hash must match the as-published noaa-gfs-bdp-pds archive
armor.roll_jump: roll-date move > 5x daily sigma without a modeled freeze event => halt (RollJumpError)
armor.on_violation: cycle REJECTED: never persisted, never fills a paper trade; alert raised

data_integrity.stored_vs_offline_equivalence: stored ColdGrip output must equal pakhi.ws1.candidate output on the same cycle, else the worker halts
data_integrity.db: Postgres (TimescaleDB optional at Phase-3 scale); paper ledger columns identical to data/ws1/t4_candidate_ledger.csv so significance_report consumes it unmodified

g2_scope: infrastructure proof only (autonomous, no-lookahead, provenance-complete store feeding the paper ledger); does NOT clear G1
anti_gaming: protocol locked in writing BEFORE any live event is recorded
theta_p frozen; no live re-estimation from the accumulating dataset
change_control: any amendment requires a new version + re-lock; accumulated paper ledger void unless re-validated
